headline: Paid Media | E-Commerce Acquisition | Creative Testing & Measurement
headline_rationale: Uproot needs daily multichannel campaign ownership, budget pacing, creative collaboration and incrementality. Emphasize supported Meta/TikTok/Google, commerce results and testing; AppLovin is an explicit unverified gap, not a claimed skill.
summary: Hands-on paid media marketer experienced in consumer e-commerce acquisition, campaign testing and budget optimization. Managed Google, Microsoft, Meta, Instagram and TikTok campaigns and scaled monthly marketing volume fourfold while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5. Analyzed incremental CPA and audience performance, tested conversion funnels and partnered with creative and web teams on campaign priorities. Builds KPI dashboards and automated reporting that connect channel results with business decisions and actionable next steps.
factual_review: Read exact Uproot Clean Sr Paid Media Buyer description and US remote terms. Supported E030/E037/E002/E003/E006/E044/E038/E009/E095. AppLovin, Northbeam, Hex, CAPI/server-side implementation, Taboola and Outbrain are not claimed. Saved match eligibility preserved without threshold changes.
tools_rationale: Use only source-supported campaign, commerce and measurement tools; requested unverified AppLovin and specialist attribution products are omitted.
